entities.name: Friedrich von Medem
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Friedrich Johann Graf von Medem was a Baltic German zoologist who emigrated to Colombia at age 38 and later became a representative of the IUCN Crocodiles Specialist Group for South America. He was also known as Federico Medem and published under this name.
